rule: Thresholds are frozen in Phase 0. Any change must be appended to changelog with date, reason and the metric values that prompted it. A reviewer agent may rule only when a metric lands within 10% of its threshold (|value - threshold| <= 0.10 * |threshold|); outside that band the number decides.

evaluation.renderer: headless Chromium, SwiftShader, so pixel tolerances apply
evaluation.group_rule: Every metric must pass on every skin-tone group separately. A tool failing any group does not ship in v1. Cross-group parity: group mean may differ from the all-group median by at most parity_relative_max.

definitions_outside_the_mask.mask_tool: Pixels where the feathered mask weight is 0 (mask dilated by the feather radius). Output must equal input within pixel_tolerance_levels.
definitions_outside_the_mask.feathered_edges: Within the feather band change must be monotone from 0 to full; no overshoot beyond the range of the pre-edit local 5x5 neighbourhood by more than halo.overshoot_levels.
definitions_outside_the_mask.warp_tool: Pixels farther than the falloff radius from every control point or stroke are unchanged within tolerance. Inside the falloff the map must be a diffeomorphism (min Jacobian determinant > 0.2).
definitions_outside_the_mask.whole_image_tool: No mask; instead identity settings must reproduce the input (max diff <= tolerance) and each control must be monotone.
definitions_outside_the_mask.patch_tool: Pixels outside brush radius + blend margin (0.25 x radius) are unchanged within tolerance.

M_outside_mask_changed_px.applies: Smooth, Whiten, Eyes, Makeup, Heal, Object erase, Background (person alpha>0.98 area)
M_outside_mask_changed_px.unit: count of pixels differing by more than pixel_tolerance_levels

M_halo_ring_mean_abs_levels.unit: 8-bit levels, mean |delta| on a 3 px ring just outside the feathered edge

M_detail_retention_default.unit: ratio: variance of Laplacian of luma on skin mask, after/before, at default strength

M_blemish_energy_reduction_max.unit: reduction of band-pass (sigma 2-6 px at fw=600) energy on skin mask at strength 100

M_skin_hue_shift_deg.unit: mean hue shift of skin mask pixels at default strength (Filters: at strength 40)

M_heal_interior_std_ratio.unit: std of luma inside brush circle / std of ring 1.0-1.5 radius around it

M_heal_seam_gradient_ratio.unit: mean gradient magnitude on the blend boundary / mean gradient magnitude of the ring

M_whiten_teeth_L_max.unit: mean CIELAB L* of teeth region at strength 100 (unnatural white above)

M_whiten_teeth_b_min.unit: mean CIELAB b* of teeth region at strength 100 (grey/blue-white below)

M_whiten_yellow_reduction_default.unit: relative drop of mean b* at default strength

M_eyes_sclera_shift_deltaE.unit: mean CIEDE2000 on sclera at default

M_eyes_iris_sharpness_gain_max.unit: relative gain of Laplacian variance in iris at clarity 100

M_clipped_px_increase.unit: fraction of pixels newly clipped to 0 or 255 at default

M_lc_monotone_violations.unit: controls swept in 21 steps: violations of monotone luma response

M_lc_neutral_shift_deltaE.unit: neutral grey patches, warmth=0, other settings at 0 -> identity

M_makeup_luma_correlation.unit: correlation of luma before/after inside the mask (texture kept)

M_warp_straight_line_residual_frac.unit: residual of fitted straight edges (door frames/tile grid in test photos + synthetic grid) as fraction of image width, at 50% strength, for edges outside the face mask

M_warp_min_jacobian.unit: min determinant of the warp Jacobian at 100% strength

M_warp_unchanged_far_px.unit: pixels beyond falloff radius that changed

M_reshape_roundtrip_levels.unit: mean abs diff of apply(+s) then apply(-s) vs original on face

M_preview_vs_export_mean_abs_levels.unit: export downscaled to preview size vs preview

M_color_roundtrip_deltaE_mean.unit: CIEDE2000 mean, identity edit, 12 MP and 48 MP

M_export_tile_seam_levels.unit: max abs diff across tile boundaries vs single-pass render on a 4096 px image

M_export_location_data_present.unit: GPS EXIF tags found in output (count)

M_crop_rotate_identity.unit: 4x rotate-90 and 2x flip return the identical pixels (diff levels); output size exact

M_face_recall_frontal.unit: detected / labelled frontal faces, per skin-tone group

M_face_recall_group_shots.unit: same, group-shot faces, per skin-tone group when present

M_face_recall_group_gap.unit: best group minus worst group recall

M_bg_hair_edge_contamination_deltaE.unit: mean CIEDE2000 of original-background colour bleed in a 6 px hair-edge band after replacing with a contrasting colour

M_bg_edge_refine_gain.unit: relative improvement in edge adherence (alpha gradient aligned with image gradient) after guided filter vs raw segmenter output

M_erase_texture_ratio.unit: Laplacian variance inside filled region / ring around it

M_erase_no_source_in_mask.unit: patch sources overlapping the erased mask (count)

runtime_budgets.per_pass_ms_software_gpu_2048: set after first measurement in Phase 1 (record, then freeze at 1.5x measured); real budget 16 ms on real iPhone, checked after handoff
